what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Peru in Spain: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 11735 Peruvian asylum seekers in Spain, 10.3% of all asylum seekers from Peru.
Refugees from Peru, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada, Spain and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Peru with Sendero Luminoso from 2007 to 2010.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Peru in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2012 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 23625, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Spain.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Spain only.
